description: This Dart source file defines an 'AgentService' class that implements a core reaction-based agent loop. It manages tools, executes actions, processes messages with a language model, and handles errors via custom exceptions. It also includes utility functions for expression evaluation and parsing.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent-related errors, carrying a specific error type and optional detail message.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class providing the core logic for a reaction-based AI agent, managing message flow, tools, and task execution.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the main agent loop, managing message exchanges with the chat service, processing actions, steps, and handling errors.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the available tools for the agent, such as file read/write, current time, and calculation.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes an action command, invoking the corresponding tool.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into a tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string to a double value.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a mathematical expression string into a list of tokens for parsing.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content enclosed within specific XML tags from a string.
